scenes.title: Hook, Problem & One-Sentence Solution
scenes.visual: **Split-Screen Hook:** Left: Web dashboard `hero` showing the keyless policy architecture card. Right: Zoomed crop of the recorded Hyperliquid testnet `3.5 NEAR` short and reduce-only close fills. At `0:06`, smooth zoom into the hero headline and `policy-v2.counterweight-samet.testnet` badge.
scenes.voiceover: Automating a Hyperliquid hedge today means handing a hot private key to an off-chain keeper. Counterweight replaces that hot key with a keyless NEAR policy contract using NEAR Chain Signatures.
scenes.caption: Replace hot keeper keys with NEAR policy.

scenes.title: Animated Mechanism
scenes.visual: **Full-Screen Animated Architecture Diagram (19 s):** Full 4-beat sequence (`Owner -> Policy Contract -> NEAR MPC v1.signer -> Hyperliquid account 0x3e72...5390`; `Keeper` valid path; `Rogue Keeper` blocked at Policy Contract; `+601s` dead-man switch close). Highlight derivation path `counterweight-1` and `0 access keys` lock icon on the Policy Contract node.
scenes.voiceover: Here is how the mechanism works. The owner deposits collateral, configures strict risk caps and a fixed withdrawal address, and deletes the contract's access key. A keeper can request bounded shorts or reduce-only closes, which v1.signer signs for the derived Hyperliquid account. Any out-of-policy request reverts.
scenes.caption: Policy contract gates NEAR MPC v1.signer signatures.

scenes.title: Local Adversarial Demo: 7/7 Rogue Rejections & Dead-Man
scenes.visual: **Local Demo Terminal (`rogue`):** Whole-line reveal of the 7 adversarial test cases (1: over-cap open, 2: price-bearing close override, 3: keeper withdrawal, 4: `approveAgent`, 5: replayed MPC callback, 6: stale price, 7: non-keeper caller), early dead-man rejection, `+601s` public dead-man close signature, and a 3.5-second hold on line `051 | PASS 7/7 rogue attempts rejected | owner untouched | close + dead-man signed`.
scenes.voiceover: We then fire seven adversarial calls at the contract: exceeding size caps, overriding close prices, keeper withdrawals, agent delegation, replayed callbacks, stale prices, and unauthorized callers. All seven revert before MPC signing, and after a 601-second timeout, the public dead-man switch signs recovery.
scenes.caption: 7/7 rogue attempts rejected; dead-man close signed.
scenes.badge: LOCAL SANDBOX · REAL WASM · MOCKED MPC/FILLS

Badge: `HISTORICAL SIMULATION · NO RETURN GUARANTEE`.
scenes.voiceover: Across 4,320 recorded mainnet hours, simulated hedged rebalancing nets $67.28, or 1.18%, with zero modeled breaches, while naive always-hedged breaches margin 1,222 times. Spot holding keeps directional exposure on a smaller capital base, small allocations lose to costs, and the retrospective out-of-sample holdout nets 0.63%.
